rate_limits: Most endpoints: 600 requests per 60 seconds in live mode and 100 per 60 seconds in test mode, per integration and endpoint. Specified live-mode endpoints have extended limits of 900–3,000 requests per 60 seconds; test mode retains standard limits.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: Original is incorrect. Paystack publishes standard per-integration, per-endpoint limits of 600 requests/60 seconds live and 100/60 seconds test. Listed live-only extended limits range from 900/60 seconds for Initiate Transfer to 3,000/60 seconds for Verify Transaction. Evidence: https://paystack.com/docs/api/rate-limits/
